name: Texas

statute.readVia: https://tcss.legis.texas.gov/resources/TN/htm/TN.547.htm (raw file behind the official statutes site)

windshield.strip: sunscreening device allowed above the AS-1 line or top 5 in., whichever is closer to the top; with the windshield at least 25% light transmission, max 25% reflectance, not red, blue or amber
windshield.reflective: max 25% luminous reflectance on the strip

frontSide.note: device + window combined at least 25%, luminous reflectance max 25%

backSide.note: side windows to the rear of the operator are exempt (547.613(b)(2-a))

rear.note: only if the vehicle has an outside mirror on each side giving a 200-ft rear view

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ('in combination with the vent or window')

tolerance.cite: Tex. Transp. Code § 547.613(d) (DPS may treat a front side window as exempt if transmission/reflectance varies by no more than 3%)

tint.dualMirrors: Outside mirror on each side (200-ft view) required for a tinted rear window
tint.certificateOrSticker: Every sunscreening device must carry a legible label, installed between film and glass, with DPS-required light transmission/reflectance info stating compliance with 547.613(b)(1) or (2); a business installing film without the label commits a misdemeanor (fine up to $1,000)

medicalExemption.text: Statutory defense to prosecution if the driver or a passenger is required for a medical reason to be shielded from direct sun (547.613(e)); no state permit described in the statute

penalty.text: Misdemeanor; general Transportation Code penalty fine $1-$200 (542.401); installer without label up to $1,000; charge may be dismissed if the defect is remedied before first court appearance (reimbursement fee max $10, 547.004(c))

quotes: a wing vent or a window that is to the left or right of the vehicle operator if the vent or window has a sunscreening device that in combination with the vent or window has: (A) a light transmission of 25 percent or more; and (B) a luminous reflectance of 25 percent or less
(2-a) a side window that is to the rear of the vehicle operator

a rear window, if the motor vehicle is equipped with an outside mirror on each side of the vehicle that reflects to the vehicle operator a view of the highway for a distance of at least 200 feet from the rear
does not extend downward beyond the AS-1 line or more than five inches from the top of the windshield, whichever is closer to the top of the windshield

It is a defense to prosecution under Subsection (a) that the defendant or a passenger in the vehicle at the time of the violation is required for a medical reason to be shielded from direct rays of the sun.

helmet.conditions: Helmet required unless the rider is 21+ and has completed an approved motorcycle safety course or is covered by a health insurance plan for motorcycle crash injuries; police may not stop riders solely to check; fine $10-$50

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Drivers under 18 may not use any wireless communication device except in an emergency (545.424); school-zone handheld bans also exist (545.425)
handheldPhone.fineText: Texting: $25-$99 first offense, $100-$200 repeat; Class A misdemeanor (up to $4,000 and 1 year) if death or serious injury

studdedTires.season: No dates in statute; studs/protuberances allowed only if they do not injure the highway

radarDetector.note: Radar detectors not banned; radar interference devices (jammers) prohibited for drivers and their sale (547.616). Commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned from detectors federally (49 CFR 392.71).

openQuestions: DPS medical exemption paperwork not checked (statute gives only a defense)
Underglow and lift rules not located (Texas has no lift statute found in ch. 547)
